home.tagline: The guessing party game where going too far earns you donkeys.

question.title: A question pops up
question.text: It always has a number for an answer, and a card with {{min}}–{{max}} donkeys.

estimate.title: Raise the estimate
estimate.text: Players take turns one after another, and everyone has to say a bigger estimate than the player before.

double.title: Double
double.text: If you think the previous estimate is too low, call "Double!" and at least double it. When the next player raises it or wrongly calls "To je priveľa!", your double held and takes one donkey off your score at the end.

call.title: "To je priveľa!"
call.text: If you think the previous player overdid it, call "To je priveľa!" instead of estimating, and the answer is revealed.

card.title: Who takes the card?
card.text: If the estimate really was over the answer, the previous player takes the card. If not, the one who called "To je priveľa!" takes it.

next.title: Next round
next.text: The player who called "To je priveľa!" starts the next round.

end.title: Game over
end.text: When someone collects too many cards, the game ends. Every double that held takes one donkey off, and the player left with the most donkeys loses.

players.title: Who's playing?
players.name: Player name
players.empty: Nobody at the table yet. Add names or tap regulars below.

label.one: bad card for one player ends the game
label.other: bad cards for one player end the game

Question.name: 🃏 From the question
Question.text: Every question comes with its own {{min}}–{{max}} donkeys.

Chooser.name: 🎯 Starting player decides
Chooser.text: Before each question only its category is shown, and the starting player sets its worth, {{min}}–{{max}} donkeys.

categories.title: Questions from
categories.empty: No categories yet. Create the first one below.

errors.noQuestions: There are no questions yet. Ask an admin to add some.
errors.tableFull: The table is full: {{max}} players at most.
errors.categoryNameLength: A category name needs {{min}} to {{max}} characters.
errors.noQuestionsAdmin: There are no questions yet. Create a category with AI questions first.

play.question: ❓ Question {{number}}

outOfQuestions.title: Out of questions!
outOfQuestions.text: These categories have no questions. Add some on the setup screen, or wrap it up here.

play.reveal: ✋ To je priveľa! Show the answer
play.doubleRule: Did a double hold? The next player raised it, so tap + by the ✌️ of whoever called it – it takes one donkey off their score at the end. Fix a mis-tap with −.
play.cardRule: Was the last estimate over the answer? Whoever said it takes the card. If not, the one who called "To je priveľa!" takes it.
play.doublesFirst: Add (+) every double ✌️ that held first, and only then hand out the card.

confirmEnd.title: End the game now?
confirmEnd.text: Results are counted as they stand, and the player with the most donkeys after doubles loses.

choose.title: Starting player: how many donkeys is this question worth?
choose.hint: Only the category is known so far. Tap a card and the question appears.

summary.cancelledText: A player was deleted, so this game ended without a result.
summary.tie: It's a tie at the bottom!

signIn.title: Sign in to play
signIn.text: Your players and games stay with your login. Everyone plays with the same questions.
signIn.name: Login name
signIn.newHint: New here? Type the login name you want and press Sign in.

ask.title: New login?
ask.text: There is no login named "{{name}}" yet. Do you want to create it?

errors.nameLength: A login name needs {{min}} to {{max}} characters.

players.title: 👥 Your players
players.text: Only you see them. Add regulars here or right at the table.
players.empty: No players yet. Add the first one!
players.confirm: Delete for good? Finished games keep their score as an unknown player; a game still running ends.
players.full: You have {{max}} players, the most a login can keep. Delete one to add another.

admin.title: 🛠️ Questions
admin.text: Every login plays with these questions. Only admins can change them.
admin.moreCount: Number of AI questions to add to {{name}}
admin.confirmAi: Delete the {{count}} AI questions of "{{name}}"? Questions added by hand stay.
